name: Asagiri Tomomi
source:
A girl in love with Yuu, leader of the Yotsuya Four Knights racing team. She's confessed to him many times and been turned down each time, perhaps due to her shyness and awkward manner of roundabout speech...

[from [url=http://www.jastusa.com/moero2/]official English site[/url]]
